correctness.rationale: Proof derives the graph metric for all positive integers, diagonalizes radial Hamming kernels with exactly normalized Fourier eigenvalues and multiplicities, supplies explicit zero-sum witnesses for every excluded case by isometric subcubes, and proves all positive cases. It obtains endpoint maxima and multiplicities analytically for both alphabet regimes. The standalone exact checker passed 5278 finite assertions including BFS and rational spectra. Finite experiments are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The full three-parameter classification identifies a structural alphabet dichotomy: the square powers of binary cubes always remain of negative type, whereas no nonbinary proper power beyond the original Hamming metric does. At the first failure it also computes sharp fractional exponents and exact critical embedding ranks, with parity-dependent large degeneracy in the binary regime. These are motivated, reusable graph-metric invariants across infinite families, not merely a calculation at one small order.
